response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws),''),'') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt*1.0/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
